items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Tossel was born, even. Okay. Okay. Tossel was two years old then.

ctx.x: He was a soloist. And he was assistant leader of the Shriners Band when the Shrine really had a band. I mean, they had bands. In that band, they had. Assistant to Tossel? Huh? Was he assistant to Tossel with the Shriners Band?
